other_failure_modes.name: Gradient-based optimization on non-differentiable metric
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses a gradient-based numerical optimizer (like SLSQP) to directly optimize a step-function metric (like ROC AUC or Accuracy). Because the metric depends only on discrete ranks, finite-difference gradients will be exactly zero almost everywhere, causing the optimizer to immediately terminate without actually tuning the weights.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured cross-validation pipeline with sound feature engineering and good deep learning regularization. However, it fails to clean the data beforehand and, critically, attempts to use SLSQP (a gradient-based optimizer) to optimize ROC AUC. Since ROC AUC is piecewise constant, the optimizer will see zero gradients and immediately exit, nullifying the ensemble weight search entirely.
